purpose: Define the outcome-blind administrative reconnaissance needed to move source-backed R1b candidate rows toward admitted or excluded status without assuming legal access or manipulation permission.

moe_izu_islands_management_office.role: Fuji-Hakone-Izu National Park Izu Islands region; Natural Parks Act consultation and permission procedures
moe_izu_islands_management_office.office: Ministry of the Environment, Kanto Regional Environment Office, Fuji-Hakone-Izu National Park Management Office, Izu Islands Ranger Office
moe_izu_islands_management_office.preconsultation_rule: Consult the nearest ranger office before finalizing a plan; exact park zone and planned acts determine whether an application or notification is required.

tokyo_education_oshima_office.role: Official contact for Oshima cultural properties including the Oshima coastal plant community natural monument
tokyo_education_oshima_office.office: Tokyo Metropolitan Board of Education, Oshima Branch Office
tokyo_education_oshima_office.procedure_note: Tokyo's current workflow for permission to alter or affect a historic site/place of scenic beauty/natural monument is submitted through the municipality and lists a standard processing period of 50 days; this does not mean every planned non-destructive action automatically requires permission.

kozu_village_industry_tourism.role: Local site-management, access, park and tourism facility reconnaissance for Kozushima candidate localities
kozu_village_industry_tourism.office: Kozushima Village Office, Industry and Tourism Division

planned_actions_to_describe_verbatim_in_: tag and repeatedly observe individual flowering plants without removing them
mount or place camera/direct-observation equipment near flowers for declared time windows
apply temporary flower bags for autonomous-pollination and single-visit controls
perform controlled single-visit pollen-deposition measurements on flowers/stigmas
apply supplemental outcross pollen by hand to designated flowers
follow treated flowers to mature fruit/seed and collect only the minimum material explicitly approved
record floral geometry before reproductive outcome
remove all temporary equipment and materials after the declared block

candidate_contact_order.candidate_group: Oshima Campanula named localities excluding automatic admission
questions: For each exact locality, what National Park zone or other protection category applies?
Which of the planned observation, camera, bagging, hand-pollination, SVD and mature-seed actions require permission or notification?
Who is the land/site manager whose consent is independently required?
Are there site-specific restrictions that make the three-treatment panel infeasible before any outcome is observed?
candidate_contact_order.admission_effect: A site remains candidate until park category, land-manager access, phenology, abundance and all structural field gates are independently verified.

questions: Does each planned non-destructive or manipulative action count as alteration or an action affecting preservation of the designated natural monument?
If permission is required, which municipality route, owner/manager consent and attachments are required?
Is temporary bagging, hand pollination, SVD handling, camera placement or minimal mature-seed collection permissible under conditions?
Which exact parts of the named coastal route fall inside the designation and National Park protection zones?
candidate_contact_order.admission_effect: High-friction candidate. Do not admit until both cultural-property and park-law routes are resolved where applicable.

questions: Confirm the exact Nodo Sainbara-line lighthouse locality, current Farfugium occurrence and the responsible land/site manager.
Is research access with temporary cameras, flower bags and hand pollination locally acceptable subject to formal permissions?
What National Park zone applies at the exact locality and which planned actions require application/notification?
Are there access, road, safety, land-use or seasonal restrictions that prevent independent repeated site-time blocks?
candidate_contact_order.admission_effect: First-priority P6 reconnaissance site; remains candidate until occurrence, access, park status, manipulation feasibility and independent-block structure pass.

questions: Can a current named Campanula microdonta population be resolved from local knowledge or lawful reconnaissance?
Which accessible localities have enough flowering plants to justify a formal plant-count screen?
What protection categories, land-manager permissions and manipulation restrictions apply at those localities?
candidate_contact_order.admission_effect: Do not assign confirmatory blocks from the historical island-level herbarium record alone.

natural_monument_rule.source: Tokyo Metropolitan Board of Education workflow current as of 2025-04-01
natural_monument_rule.legal_basis: Cultural Properties Protection Act Article 125 and related delegated provisions
natural_monument_rule.submission_route_note: Tokyo workflow states submission through the municipality and owner consent when the applicant is not the owner.
natural_monument_rule.firewall: The presence of a permit pathway is not evidence that the planned action will be permitted; no manipulation begins before required approvals are issued.

national_park_rule.source: Kanto Regional Environment Office national-park application guidance
national_park_rule.rule: Exact park zone and action type determine whether an application or notification is required; preconsult the ranger office before final plan lock.
national_park_rule.firewall: Do not infer from island name alone that a candidate is inside a particular zone or that every proposed action is prohibited or permitted.

next_state_transition: contact/reconnaissance evidence -> update candidate registry fields -> R1b audit -> only admitted rows may enter R2 pilot planning
forbidden: mark permit_status confirmed before receiving an authoritative determination
mark access confirmed from a public occurrence page alone
treat occurrence evidence as proof that the planned experimental manipulations are lawful
switch candidate priority because a focal reproductive result is favorable or adverse
begin manipulative field work before all required approvals and land-manager permissions are resolved
claim_boundary: This plan establishes who to ask and what to ask. It does not grant permission, establish current plant abundance, admit any R1b block, or constitute biological evidence.
